images.name: wood-shelf
images.prompt: Seamless tileable texture of rich polished walnut wood, horizontal grain running left to right, warm honey and chocolate tones, subtle varnish sheen, evenly lit, flat straight-on photograph, no objects, no text.

images.name: wood-wall
images.prompt: Seamless texture of dark stained oak tongue-and-groove wall paneling, vertical boards with fine grooves between them, warm low light from above, 1980s den, flat straight-on photograph, no objects, no text.

images.name: store-front
images.prompt: the inside of a cozy small-town computer software store in 1985, warm wooden shelves lined with colorful boxed software seen slightly out of focus, a beige computer on a wooden counter, brass lamp glow, green carpet, a feeling of a well-loved library. No readable writing on any box.

images.name: Dottie-hero
images.prompt: a woman architect in a cream blouse and large glasses at a wooden drafting table by a sunny window, a beige computer beside her whose green-phosphor screen shows a loose hand-drawn flowchart of boxes and arrows, pencils, a coffee mug and rolled blueprints on the desk, she is smiling at the screen.

images.name: Dottie-box
images.prompt: a giant friendly pencil drawing a wobbly hand-sketched flowchart of boxes and arrows across a starry teal and coral sky, the arrows glowing as they connect.

images.name: Fanfare-hero
images.prompt: a tall all-in-one beige computer on a plain warm grey studio sweep, lit like a product shot, its small black-and-white screen showing a grey pinstriped window with lines of text-like squiggles, a keyboard and a single-button mouse in front of it, a polished brass trumpet resting beside the keyboard.

images.name: Fanfare-box
images.prompt: a golden trumpet blowing a bright rainbow stream of glowing blocky shapes out of a grey retro computer window with a striped title bar, against a deep violet sky with spotlights.

images.name: Microfiche-hero
images.prompt: a scruffy brown-and-white terrier dog sitting upright on a wooden office chair at a desk, looking proudly at a beige computer, surrounded by neat stacks of index cards, a card file drawer, a rubber stamp and a leather notebook, warm library light.

images.name: Microfiche-box
images.prompt: a cascade of glowing index cards and checkboxes unfolding like an outline from a tiny dog's notebook, nested indented cards floating above a wooden card catalog drawer, against a midnight blue and amber sky.

images.name: TwistedPair-hero
images.prompt: a lively open-plan 1980s office meeting around a long wooden table, four colleagues in sweaters and shirtsleeves laughing together, two beige computers on the table with glowing screens, coiled telephone cables twisting across the table, a friendly small toy robot sitting at the table as if it were a colleague.

images.name: TwistedPair-box
images.prompt: two glowing cables, one orange and one blue, twisting around each other in a double helix that rises from a desk telephone, little speech-bubble shapes and a cheerful small robot riding along the cable, against a dusk gradient sky.

images.name: rabbit-ears-manager-hero
images.prompt: a 1980s wood-paneled living room in the evening, a family on a plaid sofa watching a big wood-grain console television topped with silver rabbit-ear antennas, the screen showing a blue weather map with sun and cloud symbols, a father at a nearby desk adjusting things on a beige computer.

images.name: rabbit-ears-manager-box
images.prompt: a chrome rabbit-ear television antenna atop a wood-grain TV set, beaming colorful broadcast waves into a sky full of weather symbols, satellites and channel tiles, against a deep blue and orange sunset.

images.name: jeo-paw-dy-player-hero
images.prompt: a 1990s family game night in a bright living room, a happy scruffy terrier dog sitting on the sofa between laughing teenagers, one teen holding up a phone-sized handheld buzzer, a television in the background showing a grid of bright blue tiles, bowls of popcorn.

images.name: jeo-paw-dy-player-box
images.prompt: a cheerful scruffy terrier dog in a tiny bow tie hosting a game show, standing before a glowing grid of blue tiles, confetti and Memphis-style squiggles, triangles and dots in teal, magenta and yellow.

images.name: herdr-phin-util-hero
images.prompt: a calm sheepdog lying beside an engineer in a denim shirt at a wooden desk late at night, the engineer pressing one key on a beige keyboard, the green-phosphor screen split into several neat tiled panes, a desk lamp glowing, a window showing a moonlit field.

images.name: herdr-phin-util-box
images.prompt: a sheepdog herding a flock of glowing terminal windows into a tidy grid of panes across a moonlit green hillside, a starry indigo sky.

images.name: Slaps-hero
images.prompt: a startled businessman in a brown suit and wide tie at a cluttered office desk, leaning back in surprise with his coffee mid-air, as the beige computer's whole screen flashes bright red and yellow with a big alarm-clock shape, a wall clock behind him showing one minute to the hour, sunlight through venetian blinds.

images.name: Slaps-box
images.prompt: a giant cartoon alarm clock bursting through a computer screen in a starburst of red and yellow, little calendar pages and a telephone flying out, bold comic-style action lines against a hot pink and orange sky.

images.name: Welty-hero
images.prompt: a cozy 1980s home study in soft morning light, a woman in a cardigan holding a coffee mug and smiling at a beige computer on a wooden roll-top desk, a tidy wooden letter sorter with neat little cubbies beside the computer, a scruffy terrier dog sitting proudly at her feet with an envelope in its mouth, houseplants on the windowsill.

images.name: Welty-box
images.prompt: a flock of white envelopes flying like paper birds out of an open rural mailbox on a wooden post and settling into neat glowing wooden pigeonholes, against a dawn sky fading from deep teal to peach.

images.name: TwistedPairServer-hero
images.prompt: a proud office manager in a necktie and rolled-up sleeves standing beside a tall beige tower computer in a small 1980s office back room, a wall-mounted patch panel with neatly coiled orange and blue cables, blinking green lights, a cheerful small toy robot sitting on top of the tower, colleagues visible through a doorway at their desks.

images.name: TwistedPairServer-box
images.prompt: a tall glowing beige server tower rising like a skyscraper at dusk, orange and blue twisted cables running out from its base to a ring of small desk telephones and computers, a cheerful small robot waving from a lit window near the top, against a deep violet to orange sky.

images.name: herdr-phin-picker-hero
images.prompt: a programmer in a cardigan at a wooden desk at dusk, one finger on a beige keyboard, the green-phosphor screen showing a neat vertical list of project names with one highlighted, a friendly cream mutt with floppy ears resting its chin on the desk beside the keyboard, a brass desk lamp, index cards pinned to a corkboard.

images.name: herdr-phin-picker-box
images.prompt: a glowing teal magnifying glass picking one shining folder out of a swirling constellation of hundreds of tiny folders and branching git-tree lines, against a deep indigo and teal night sky with sparkles.

images.name: redpen-hero
images.prompt: a busy software engineer in a cardigan at a cluttered wooden desk in late afternoon light, holding a bright red pen over a tall stack of printed code listings on green-bar tractor-feed paper, a beige computer with a glowing screen beside her, a row of manila folders in an in-tray, a scruffy brown-and-white terrier dog asleep on a pile of folders under the desk.

images.name: redpen-box
images.prompt: a giant glowing red pen sweeping a bold check mark across the whole painting, through a sky full of floating blank sheets of green-bar computer paper marked only with plain horizontal stripes, the sheets lined up in a tidy queue that recedes toward the horizon, against a deep crimson and indigo gradient sky that runs to every edge of the picture.

images.name: Cubicle-box
images.prompt: a small cheerful office worker in a tie sitting at a little desk inside one glowing amber cubicle, typing at a glowing monitor, while many more open cubicle cells with slate-blue fabric walls and polished brass rails float away in rows into a deep violet and orange twilight sky, each cell a little dimmer than the last, tiny paper airplanes hopping from cell to cell leaving trails of light.

images.name: Cubicle-hero
images.prompt: a friendly young woman with a bob haircut, a bright cardigan and big round glasses sits at a desk in an open-plan office of fabric-walled cubicles, her hands on the keyboard of a beige computer, smiling at its green-phosphor screen, which shows a tidy grid of four rectangles with one rectangle glowing warm amber; a coffee mug, a desk lamp, a potted fern and a filing cabinet around her, and rows of identical cubicles stretching away behind her.

images.name: corkboard-hero
images.prompt: a rumpled project manager in shirtsleeves and a loosened tie stands before a big cork board filling an office wall, covered in index cards pinned in tidy columns and joined by taut red, blue and yellow strings running between brass push pins, pointing at one card with a pencil while a colleague holding a coffee mug looks on, unconvinced; a beige computer on the desk beside them, venetian-blind window light striping the wall.

images.name: corkboard-box
images.prompt: a glowing cork board floating in a vast sky, covered in index cards in neat columns, linked by luminous red, gold and blue strings that hang in soft arcs between shining brass tacks, a few cards drifting loose toward the board, against a deep burgundy and dusk-orange gradient sky.

images.name: boiler-room-hero
images.prompt: a relaxed Black man in his forties wearing a cardigan, reading a paperback in a comfortable armchair with his feet up on an ottoman and a mug of cocoa beside him; curled up asleep on the ottoman next to his feet is Pepper, the scruffy brown-and-white terrier from the reference photograph; on the desk behind them a beige computer quietly works on its own, its screen a plain soft amber glow with nothing written on it, a small brass pressure gauge sitting on top of the monitor, warm evening lamp light, a window showing dusk.

images.name: boiler-room-box
images.prompt: a gleaming brass boiler with round pressure gauges, valves and copper pipes filling the lower half of the picture, curls of steam rising and turning into little clock faces and paper envelopes, one gauge glowing as its needle swings, the painted sky behind it fading from deep amber at the horizon to midnight blue at the top edge, the sky and the painting reaching every edge of the frame.
